findings.claim: SIMO 與 MaxLinear 已於 2023-07-26 取得中國 SAMR 反壟斷批准；其後 MaxLinear 片面終止合併，SIMO 在新加坡 SIAC 仲裁求償 1.6 億美元終止費，聽證已結束、等待終局裁決。
findings.excerpt: On July 26, 2023, the Company and MaxLinear received antitrust approval from the State Administration for Market Regulation of the People’s Republic of China (“SAMR Approval”).

findings.claim: 20-F 法律程序章節：管理層認為一般訴訟不致造成重大不利影響；唯一點名的重大程序為對 MaxLinear 的 SIAC 仲裁，未列反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: management does not believe that the outcome of any of these matters will have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial position or cash flows.

note: 2026 搜尋無新的反壟斷／拆分／出口管制來源；搜尋結果僅有 2023 年併購舊聞。
